name: B10-0220/2026 (Renew) – Escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and calling for action on Haiti, where criminal groups control much of the capital and traffic and exploit people, especially children. It asks for trafficking networks to be broken up, including by tracking their money and prosecuting the people who run and fund them. It also wants more sanctions, a stronger international security mission, tighter enforcement of the United Nations arms embargo, and more humanitarian aid.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is a set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Haiti's people, especially children and women, and the groups trafficking them.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to Haiti's government, European Union institutions and international bodies.
